similarityReview: The model successfully captures the massive, wide-spreading canopy of the banyan tree using multiple ellipsoid_sphere components to simulate the dense, layered foliage. The trunk is represented by a large conical_frustum with base root structures, accurately reflecting the buttress roots typical of such trees. The scale is set to match a large mature tree (approx 15m height). The color palette adheres to the 7-Zone system, with facadeHex for the trunk and roofHex for the canopy.
